sn12.32:1.2: Kaḷāra the Aristocrat is otherwise unknown.
sn12.32:1.4: For Phagguna of the Top-Knot, see note on [sn12.12:2.1]().
sn12.32:8.5: Read _khīṇasmiṁ khīṇam’iti_ with PTS and BJT, paralleling the common idiom _vimuttasmiṁ vimuttam’iti_ ([sn12.61:6.2]()). | The syntax here is convoluted: “With the end of that source which is the source of rebirth, I knew regarding that ending, ‘it is ended’.”
sn12.32:14.9: Variants for _nānussavanti_ are from the roots _sav_ (“flow”) and _sī_ (“lie”). Pali often couples verbs and nouns from the same root for emphasis, and this is probably the case here, hence, “defilements don’t defile”.
